established: A **blob** is any byte string, addressed by `sha256(bytes)`.
residual: this record cites its witness cases and mutants and does not run them; CI runs the suites and tests/mutants.py before tools/claims.py check
any byte string: empty and non-UTF-8 blobs are kept (E8), and no rule restricts blob bytes, so that half has no mutant of its own; M66 burns the address (a blob counts only under its own hash)
